reviews.comment: Professor Dockery is a great guy and an effective professor. Taking him for public speaking caused me to refine my skills at public speaking while having a good time. Lectures were great use of time - He was a very memorable and concise lecturer, and if he said all he needed to before class ended, he would dismiss class early.

Taking this during the summer was a breeze! You're graded by 4 speeches that each follow the same worksheet and outline format (last speech is a group project). Every time I emailed him a question, he would answer quickly. Got 90 or above on all speeches with great feedback. This class is an amazing GPA boost and a useful skill to learn.

COMM 243: Absolutely amazing I could not recommend him more. He got to know every student by their name and took interest in getting to know everyone. He allowed me to do an honors contract which was awesome and engaging. He gave amazing feedback and helped me become better even as a veteran debater. You do 3 partner debates and little assignments.

My absolute favorite class at TAMU so far. Had amazing lectures, knew each student by name, gave amazing feedback and allowed for resubmissions of assignments. He really wanted you to learn how to speak well and convey your thoughts. Nicest guy- very funny. Has you partnered debates which are work but not bad at all. Learned and improved so much!
